Join Fishbox now and find out how to maximize your fishing success. The app is great for both freshwater and saltwater fishermen around the world. Download Fishbox App for FREE. 

HIT THE WATER AT THE RIGHT TIME - don’t miss the best time to hit the water with Fishbox fishing forecast!
• Fishbox's unique algorithm analyzes 41 weather parameters that impact fish behavior and make real time predictions, when the best time to fish is expected
• Shows the reasons why fish won’t bite
• Developed in collaboration with ichthyologists and professional anglers with 20+ years of experience
• Uses the most accurate sources of weather data 
• Available for any body of water all over the world
• Approved by local anglers

PLAN YOUR TRIPS IN ADVANCE - get all the data you need to plan a trip and keep an eye on the changing weather when fishing to adjust your methods just in time!
• 7-DAY detailed weather forecast
• Hourly detailed weather forecast (wind strength and direction, atmospheric pressure,precipitation, etc)
• Waves charts (period, direction and temperature)
• Tides charts (low & high, tidal current)
• Solunar

FIND NEW IDEAS WHERE TO GO
• Explore Fishbox fishing map with more than 1.2 million public water bodies all over the world
• Get access to secret fishing spots, recommended by local anglers
• Nautical maps by NOAA 

CREATE YOUR CUSTOMIZED FISHING MAP
• Save your favorite spots to have its fishing forecast and detailed weather forecast always on hand - here's no limit in adding your spots
• Save your catches - advanced catch log, a possibility to add photos
• Enable personalized notifications and stay informed when it is the best bite time to fish in your places

BECOME A KNOT TYING PRO
• Explore Fishbox TOP knots collection - over 50 knots!
• Find the perfect  knot for any situation
• Master knots with step-by-step video guides

PERSONALIZE YOUR EXPERIENCE WITH THE APP
• Personal assistant
• Apple watch App
• Personalized map settings
• Users guides and FAQs
